verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented retention settings or data-deletion controls. The only related item is a changelog note that Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data to keep it longer than Honeybadger stores it. That is an export feature adjacent to retention, not a way to set retention periods or delete stored data. Dashboard deletion via MCP concerns dashboards, not retained error or event data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
